sentence: This project studies how graph topology and network architecture affect the performance of graph neural networks and how to make them more efficient.
This project builds a low-cost sensor that uses microwave photonics and polymer micro-ring resonators to detect circulating tumor DNA in human blood.
This project studies quantum networks, from single photon emitters and qubit realization to quantum sensors and quantum random number generators.
This project builds patient-derived, multicellular tissue models to study colitis-associated cancer, a form of colorectal cancer driven by chronic inflammation.
This project studies which ecological and evolutionary factors shape communities of giant viruses in a coastal ecosystem over a year.
This project builds statistical tools for drawing inferences from network data, including methods for prediction, regression and the permutation test.
This project builds scalable software that combines single cell data to build gene regulatory networks and study how cells communicate with each other.
This project studies how unusual lipids in the membranes of plant chloroplasts help plants survive freezing.
This project builds secure protocols for payment channel networks that let blockchains handle more transactions by processing them off-chain.
This project studies how short, intense pulses of light heat thin-film semiconductors on plastic substrates to make flexible transistors that perform well and last.
This project tries to find out when a conjecture about quantum correlation between two parties holds, and extends it to more than two quantum measurement bases.
This project builds quantum devices, systems and algorithms with industry, and studies quantum simulations of physical phenomena such as spin chemistry.
This project develops robots that correct their own mistakes within a few tries, without retraining, by learning from failures during training.
This project uses variational quantum algorithm techniques on quantum computer systems to study hypersonic flow and design 2D quantum materials.
This project designs long noncoding RNAs that silence large parts of chromosomal DNA, and tests them in mammalian cells and yeast.
This project builds theoretical models of how Rydberg excitons in semiconductors interact with crystal impurities and with light.
This project studies fast radio bursts by imaging their host galaxies, to learn about cosmology, baryons and what produces the bursts.
